name: Chelsea Rebecca
bio: Chelsea Rebecca was born on 5 July 1990 in the United States. She is an actress, voice actress, producer and host, known for Scream (2022), Dead Meat Podcast (2018), The Kill Count (2017) and Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game (2024). She has been married to James A. Janisse since 21 January 2022.

credits.title: Mental Health and Horror: A Documentary
credits.overview: Mental Health and Horror: A Documentary is a feature-length documentary about the positive impacts and cathartic releases that horror can have on those living with mental illnesses.

credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: The Red Mask

credits.title: Frankenbabes from Beyond the Grave!
credits.overview: Frankenscience and religious ideology reanimate a cohort of recently deceased fetishists to create the perfectly subservient woman only to unleash hell on the patriarchy.

credits.overview: Mindy, a young widow and mother who tries to protect her daughter Alice from a flesh eating monster named Agyar. Mindy has been secretly sacrificing her own life by allowing the creature to feast on her body as she keeps Alice hidden away at her grandmother’s house.

credits.title: Scream
credits.overview: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a new killer has donned the Ghostface mask and begins targeting a group of teenagers to resurrect secrets from the town’s deadly past.

credits.title: Hashtag
credits.overview: In a future where social media dominates every moment of our lives, "X" has attained unprecedented celebrity but obscurity is just a click away.

credits.title: In Search of Darkness
credits.overview: An exploration of '80s horror movies through the perspective of the actors, directors, producers and SFX craftspeople who made them, and their impact on contemporary cinema.
